foodStyle: Create one photorealistic professional food photograph for a warm, romantic Chinese couples menu app. Landscape 4:3 composition. One real finished dish, beautifully and authentically cooked, fully recognizable. View from a 45-degree slightly overhead food photography angle. Center the generous serving in an elegant shallow warm ivory ceramic dish, on a light honey oak dining table, a soft oatmeal linen corner at the edge, minimal restrained props. Natural warm window light from upper left, gentle soft shadows, realistic food texture and appetizing subtle sauce highlights. Refined home-cooking editorial photography, cozy and welcoming, not excessively stylized. Food fills most of the middle 70% of the frame, keep the whole plate inside frame and leave crop-safe margins for mobile cards. No people, no hands, no letters, no labels, no text, no logos, no watermark, no collage, no illustration or emoji.
notes: Food-specific briefs describe the required ingredients; each asset was generated separately. Native and web exports differ only in resolution and compression.

hero.prompt: Create a beautiful wide 3:2 hero banner illustration for a pink romantic Chinese home-cooking menu web app. Match a soft, warmly lit, pastel storybook anime food illustration. Hello Kitty, the recognizable white cat with black oval eyes, yellow oval nose, no mouth, red bow on upper right of her head from viewer perspective, wearing a pink gingham apron with frills, is cooking with a wooden spoon in a large pink heart-pattern casserole pot. Character occupies the right half, head in upper right. Cozy cream and blush pink kitchen with sunlit window, green plants and little strawberries in background. Foreground dining counter covered with several gorgeous Chinese dishes including tomato scrambled eggs, green peppers stir fried pork, red braised pork and a bowl of stew. On left half mostly warm pale peach kitchen wall with a few tiny pink hearts and strawberries, keeping space in lower left clear for white title overlay. Overall dreamy soft peach-pink, high detail food and hand-painted light, adorable and welcoming. No text, no letters, no UI, no phone frame, no watermark. Landscape wide composition, clean edges. This is a standalone background image for a hero.
